definitions.f_x: f(s) = Z - 41.78214 s^2 sum_i a_i exp(-b_i s^2), s = sin(theta)/lambda = |g|/2, |g| = 1/d (no 2 pi)
definitions.intensity: 2 |F|^2 LP over the Friedel half-space (F = sum_e f_e exp(-B_e s^2) sum_j occ_j exp(2 pi i h.r_j)), merged where round(2theta / 1e-5) is equal, peaks at or below 1e-3 percent of the strongest dropped, scaled so the strongest is 100
definitions.families: pymatgen get_unique_families: hkl and -hkl of every merged reflection, grouped by sorted |indices|, each named by its largest member; four indices (h, k, -h-k, l) when Lattice.is_hexagonal()
